name: Andy Daly
bio: Andy Daly, born on April 15, 1971, is an American actor, comedian, and writer celebrated for his versatile comedic talents and sharp wit. His journey into comedy began with improvisational theatre, honing his skills and developing a knack for creating memorable characters. Daly gained prominence through various comedic roles in television and film. He showcased his talent for improvisation and character-driven comedy in shows like "Mad TV" and "Reno 911!" where his ability to portray a wide range of eccentric personalities became evident. One of his most notable projects includes the Comedy Central series "Review," where he portrayed the character Forrest MacNeil, a critic who reviews life experiences, leading to hilariously absurd situations.
